headline: Both approaches answered the eight test questions correctly
recommendation: Keep deterministic acquisition and reusable, page-linked reports. Both upfront loading and sequential tool reading are viable for this corpus; the experiment found no answer-quality winner. Preserve original-page checks and explicit calculations in either workflow.
scoring_basis: Independent read-only reviewer; frozen source-based rubric; complete final answers scored; no deductions

questions.finding: All 20 figures, units and cumulative-growth calculations matched. Alternative financial/APM page citations were valid.
Both distinguished volume, currency, fabrication revenue, aluminium pass-through and other revenue.
Both cited year-specific milestones and distinguished completed projects from expectations.
Both preserved volume/share and absolute/intensity distinctions, plus reporting-perimeter qualifications.
Both preserved the published totals and exposed the residual. Tools wording was slightly too certain about rounding.
Both separated realized effects, changing expectations and unrecognized insurance recovery.
Both retained the source's rounded-value discrepancy and reconciled cumulative costs.
Both preserved the conflicting dates and break-even statements without inventing a resolution.

minor_wording_note: Tools Q5 calls the unexplained difference a rounding residual. Prefer residual consistent with rounding; the exact cause was not established. Original candidate answers are preserved unchanged.
limitations: One company, one run per workflow and eight known questions. A 40/40 score applies to this rubric, not every possible fact or valuation conclusion.
The company is classified as Large Cap. Smaller-company reporting and open-ended risk discovery remain untested.
Upfront compaction was disabled; tool-reading compaction was enabled and occurred once. This is not an isolated causal test of exposure method alone.
All prepared text pages were supplied in both modes. That proves exposure, not comprehension. Selectively skipping documents was not tested.
Representative extraction QA found split digits and altered reading order. Original-page checks remain necessary for material numeric inputs.
The original acquisition used issuer IR PDFs. Separate MFN discovery found all eight releases, but attachment downloads returned 403. Börsdata ingestion was not part of either model run.
The installed Codex CLI rejected GPT-6.1 Sol; both successful trials used the existing pi route with that exact model. The future website/Codex SDK integration was not tested.
